program: Brand Allowance Program (BAP) / Retail Marketing Program (RMP)
source: Nissan BAP Guidelines, Nissan RMP Guidelines

checks.title: Nissan Logo Usage
checks.description: Nissan logo must be used per current brand standards. The flat 2D Nissan logo (2020+ redesign) must be used — not the legacy 3D chrome badge.

checks.title: Logo Clear Space
checks.description: Minimum clear space must be maintained around the Nissan logo. No text, graphics, or other brand elements may encroach on the clear space zone.

checks.title: Nissan Approved Fonts
checks.description: Must use Nissan-approved typefaces (Nissan Brand, Nissan AG). Web-safe fallbacks (Arial, Helvetica) are acceptable for digital where brand fonts are unavailable.

checks.title: Nissan Brand Colors
checks.description: Nissan brand red (#C3002F) is the primary accent color. Black and white are supporting colors. Dealer website Nissan sections should use the approved palette.

checks.title: Vehicle Photography Standards
checks.description: Vehicle photos must accurately represent the vehicle being advertised. Must use Nissan-approved studio shots or actual dealer inventory photos. No unauthorized stock images.

checks.title: MSRP Presentation
checks.description: MSRP must be clearly labeled. Cannot present MSRP as dealer's own price. Must include destination and handling charge.

checks.title: VIN Requirement for Specific Vehicle Pricing
checks.description: When advertising a specific vehicle at a specific price, the VIN (or distinguishing portion) must be included per Nissan BAP and CA law.

checks.title: NMAC Finance/Lease Attribution
checks.description: Lease and finance offers through Nissan Motor Acceptance Corporation (NMAC) must be properly attributed. Terms must match current NMAC programs.

checks.title: Nissan CPO Program Branding
checks.description: Only vehicles certified through Nissan's official CPO program may use Nissan Certified Pre-Owned branding. Must follow Nissan CPO visual standards.

checks.title: Nissan Model Name Accuracy
checks.description: Nissan model names must be used correctly (e.g., 'Nissan Altima' not 'Altima by Nissan'). Trim levels (S, SV, SL, SR, Platinum) must be accurate.

checks.title: Third-Party Content Separation
checks.description: Non-Nissan third-party vendor content should be clearly separated from Nissan-branded content areas on the dealer website.

checks.title: Nissan Prohibited Words/Phrases
checks.description: Cannot use certain prohibited terms in Nissan advertising per BAP guidelines. Includes unauthorized superlatives, unsubstantiated claims, and disparagement of other brands.

checks.title: No Unauthorized Nissan Trademark Use
checks.description: Cannot modify Nissan trademarks, create unauthorized composite logos, or use Nissan brand elements in non-approved contexts.

checks.title: Nissan Required Disclaimers
checks.description: Nissan-required disclaimers must appear on all advertising using Nissan branding or referencing Nissan offers. Includes trademark attribution and offer terms.

checks.title: Nissan EV / ARIYA / LEAF Branding
checks.description: Nissan electric vehicles (ARIYA, LEAF) have specific branding requirements. Range claims must include EPA estimated range disclaimers.
